capabilityMatrix.description: Deterministic flat Activity membership planning, revision supersession, baseline restoration, and authoritative model-visibility state.
Final-player reachability inspection, runtime reflection and AOT evidence verification, exact generated linker preservation, and strict stripping gates.

General HTTP/API request construction, explicit environment/client/catalog composition, layered policy resolution, transport, authentication, cancellation, response handling, and serializer integration.

Editor-only build workflow registration, Build Profile policy and drift validation, final-player AOT inspection, evidence verification, generated linker input, artifact manifests, and headless CI entry points.
Camera pose capture/apply, bounds framing, camera movement, orbit/fly controls, projection transitions, and waypoint navigation.
Command protocol codecs, canonical JSON envelope mapping, result encoding, metadata, and secret-safe protocol boundaries.
Transport-independent command envelopes, explicit handler strategies, middleware, dispatch, JSON protocol, secret redaction, bounded command history, and command diagnostics.
UDP command transport lifecycle, Unity-context delivery, safe responses, and Python interoperability for Deucarian Command Routing.
Secure direct-page and parent-iframe command transport lifecycle, exact-origin validation, ready handshake, browser responses, and outbound events for Deucarian Command Routing.
Diagnostics providers, snapshots, JSON export, overlays, and aggregation.
Shared editor chrome, icons, resources, style tokens, editor-only UI Toolkit helpers.
Shared game content authoring editor window, provider registration/discovery, validation display, asset path helpers, and creation-result UI.
Reflection-free generated JSON codecs, compile-time contract validation, analyzers, and serialization evidence for Unity player DTOs.
Category-based local package logging and Unity console forwarding.
Typed image, audio, video, text, and binary loading with explicit resource ownership and latest-request coordination.
Media playback sessions, preparation lifecycle, playback state observation, and Unity audio/video adapters.
Object, scene, and AssetBundle loading lifecycle and handles.
Package discovery, install/update/remove, channels, registry composition, and ecosystem visualization.
Cross-platform pointer-lock lifecycle, capture permission, input-neutral rearming, WebGL bridge state, and pointer capture diagnostics.
Catalog, category hierarchy, dependency metadata, Integration metadata, Suite metadata, and governance metadata.
Generic keyed repositories, selection state, and repository primitives.
Runtime palettes, theme assets, color roles, and UI theme adapters.
Authenticated session lifecycle, restore, refresh, logout, and persistence contracts.
Shared normalized easing presets used by Deucarian package-owned motion systems.
Simultria environment and endpoint definitions, typed lookups, viewer authentication provider, and deterministic viewer-model resolution.
Credential-free Simultria viewer profiles, stable editor/runtime authentication handoff, trusted API-client composition, sanitized connection status, and command-routed development auto-load tooling.
Collection-to-UI synchronization and presentation binding.
UI routing, screens, channels, modals, guards, transitions, and back navigation.
Reusable UI motion profiles, animated visibility, and cancellable icon/content reveal helpers.
Reusable UI Toolkit and uGUI glass panels, icon buttons, control islands, scrubbers, and presentation chrome.
Safe destruction of transient UnityEngine.Object instances across Play Mode and Edit Mode.

Canonical viewer session composition, live access-token replacement and refresh commands, sanitized auth status, shared development authentication tooling, and an optional runtime connection-provider seam.
Canonical viewer navigation action/state coordination, reference bounds and origin wiring, input blocking, toolbar presentation, and view cube UX.
Canonical viewer camera, lighting, URP quality, post-processing, reflection, themed environment, and display-settings composition.
Canonical viewer status, diagnostics, display-settings chrome, responsive layout, menu coordination, theming, and input-boundary composition.
Keyed world-object selection, hover tracking, raycast adapters, and highlight hooks.
XR-ready world-space uGUI pressable controls, poke affordances, and world canvas event-camera helpers.
